purpose: Teach: ほうれん草/ワックス/立ち寄る/小さめ/お喋り/ひと言/燃やす/グチ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、給食の、本気で、絶対、ほうれん草、絶対、お浸し、絶対、好きだよね?本気で
lines.en: Riku, you seriously love the spinach ohitashi at lunch, don't you?
lines.style: Playful challenge with genuine curiosity underneath. Quick, bright attack. Teasing lilt on the question — she already knows the answer and likes watching him react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。家の床、本気で、絶対、ワックス、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、磨いたぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Dad and I polished the floor at home until it shined, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the admission. Slight lift on 「磨いたぜ」— not boasting, just genuinely satisfied with the work. Steady eye contact with her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰りに、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんちに、絶対、立ち寄る、絶対、よ、リク
lines.en: I'm stopping by my grandma's place on the way home, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement that's also a softening. No rising intonation — she's decided this and it's gentle, not dismissive. Almost conversational aside.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ぼくより、絶対、小さめ、絶対、のリュック、絶対、使ってるよな、桜
lines.en: You're carrying a pretty small backpack compared to mine, aren't you?
lines.style: Casual observation delivered without accusation. Slight warmth — he's noticing her, the small details about her. Steady, easy pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、長い、絶対、お喋り、絶対、楽しいよ、リク
lines.en: Talking with you for hours like this is really fun, Riku.
lines.style: Sincere and unguarded. Slight breath before the words land — she's being honest and it costs something. No irony. Warm fade at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前から、本気で、絶対、ひと言、絶対、応援、絶対、もらったら、絶対、頑張れるぜ、桜
lines.en: When you encourage me, even just one word, I can really push through, Sakura.
lines.style: Tender and almost vulnerable. Slower pace. The words are careful — he's admitting something. Soft landing on her name, like a gift.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、本気で、絶対、不要書類、絶対、燃やす、絶対、コーナー、絶対、あったよね、リク
lines.en: Remember that corner at the cultural festival where we burned the old paperwork?
lines.style: Nostalgic and slightly amused. Light, conversational — pulling up a shared memory like it's a small secret between them. Gentle question mark at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、グチ、絶対、を、絶対、言ってもしょうがないぜ、桜
lines.en: There's no point complaining before an exam — it doesn't help anything.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Steady tone without lecturing. Slight resolve underneath — he's learned this about himself. Not harsh, just real.
